survey_before_predeclaration: Run before writing the gates, no production code changed: on a 1 h arc with 121 Canberra rows, one_way_light_time position Jacobians against Richardson central differences (floor 5.2e-7): analytic_first_order_light_time 4.6 percent per row at most, implicit_light_time 5.1e-7. BLS-LM reaches the same fixed point with both (0.16 mm and 0.09 mm). normalize_jacobian_model leaves the scenario field default analytic_exact_geometric as it is on a light-time profile, so a light-time scenario runs the first-order mapping while its output says exact geometric. The implicit near-zenith error applies within 1e-6 rad of zenith (0.2 arcsec). Companion range beside barycentric counted Doppler differs from the SSB one-way range by 37.4-37.6 km (apparent_one_way) and 35.5-39.5 km (instantaneous), angles by about 31 urad: slice 2.
scope_slice_1: MEAS-10: measurements.normalize_jacobian_model resolves, on any light-time profile or apparent companion geometry, both None and the inapplicable label analytic_exact_geometric to implicit_light_time. Explicit analytic_first_order_light_time stays available. The geometric instantaneous default stays analytic_exact_geometric. Observations are not touched; only Jacobians and therefore iteration paths and covariances of light-time runs change.
out_of_scope_slice_1: the companion geometry of barycentric Doppler (slice 2); the default range_rate_physics; the scenario field's own default value, which is part of the cached-package identity

G1_richardson_order.rule: central differences of re-propagated arcs converge to the implicit Jacobian at second order: with steps 8, 4, 2 km and 8, 4, 2 m/s, the median over rows of the max error relative to the row norm falls by a factor in [3, 5] per halving, in both halvings

G2_jacobian_accuracy.rule: the default Jacobian of one_way_light_time matches the Richardson reference (steps 40, 20, 10 m and 0.04, 0.02, 0.01 m/s) within 2e-6 of the row norm on every row; explicit analytic_first_order_light_time misses it by more than 1 percent on some row (it stays a documented approximation)

G3_resolution_table.rule: None and analytic_exact_geometric resolve to implicit_light_time for one_way_light_time, its aberrated profiles, the SSB profiles and apparent_one_way companion; explicit first-order is preserved; the geometric instantaneous default stays analytic_exact_geometric; implicit on geometric instantaneous still raises

G4_observations_unchanged.rule: generated observations are bitwise equal between the default and explicit first-order models

G5_estimators.rule: BLS-LM and SRIF with the default model from a 100 m start: position < 1 cm and velocity < 1e-5 m/s, each no worse than 1.5 x the explicit first-order run or below 1 mm

G6_covariance.rule: the BLS-LM posterior sigmas with the default model match sqrt(diag(inv(H^T W H))) built from the Richardson Jacobian within 1 percent on all six states; the first-order ratio is reported

G7_scenario_route_label.rule: a scenario with measurement_model_profile=one_way_light_time and no jacobian_model reaches its pass geometry as implicit_light_time, the label no longer says exact geometric

G8_full_regression.rule: full regression green; every changed test pin and every changed protected file is listed in the slice commit

reject_if: a gate fails as computed; a changed tolerance after a result goes to docs/assurance/amendment-log.md and the result is exploratory
